input.title: Add your security key to the team's GitHub
input.brief:
1. Plug your YubiKey into the Mac.
2. Open https://github.com/settings/security signed in as bea-gh.
3. Under Security keys press Register new security key and name it bea-yubikey.
4. Touch the gold disc on the key when the browser asks.
